messages:
mira: quick owners thread — we need a short launch-intake + exception playbook for pilots. goal: one-page shareable doc for sales by EOD.

anya: I can make the intake form. fields: customer, contact, requested SLA, term, burst allowance, expected qps, and escalation contact.

sam: product note: default hosted SLA = 99.5% availability. 99.9% only for Dedicated + reserved capacity + documented mitigations.

kyle: pricing note: propose 30d pilot burst allowance with overage cap. finance needs example invoice lines. I'll draft with PROVISIONAL numbers.

leo: ops needs: canary window, regional isolation, quota guard (soft warn @80%, hard cap), and automatic fallback policy on sustained p95 degradation.

eva: i'll author the one-pager and include a billing example snippet and a sales shareable checklist.

dan-legal: legal can provide an addendum template once SLA % and term are confirmed. include a revocation clause.

sam: fallback runbook sketch to include:
- Trigger: p95 > 500ms for 5m
- Action: try autoscale (2m) -> if fail, switch affected tenants to fallback model variant + enforce hard cap
- Notify: page oncall + sales_ops channel
- Revert: p95 < 350ms for 10m

mira: owners recap: intake/form 1 anya; one-pager & billing example 1 eva; pricing draft 1 kyle; fallback/runbook 1 sam; alerts + canary ops 1 leo; legal addendum 1 dan-legal. deploy-bot: canary slot?

deploy-bot: Canary slot requested: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC (pending ops).

oncall-bot: Reminder: update oncall rotation in runbook.

mira: syncing 3pm to review the one-pager before handing to sales. keep it <1p. :white_check_mark:

participants: mira/sam/anya/kyle/leo/eva/dan-legal/deploy-bot/oncall-bot
